_comment: Copy this file to ~/.linkedin-lead-system/config.json and fill it in. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored. README.md explains every setting.

_help.offer: Two or three plain sentences: what you sell, who it is for, and the result. The closer answers questions only from this text.
_help.offer_url: Optional. A page with your current pricing. Price questions get pointed here, never a number. Leave empty to send price questions toward a call instead.
_help.booking_link: Your calendar booking page. Used only on the second rung of the call ladder.
_help.icp_description: Who you want to talk to: role, company size, industry, anything that matters. Prospects are scored 0 to 100 against this.
_help.niche_keywords: Search terms for finding creators in your niche, for example ["cold email", "outbound sales"].
_help.disqualifiers: People to reject outright, for example ["recruiters", "students", "agencies selling the same service"].
_help.tone_samples: Two to five messages you actually sent on LinkedIn. Messages are written to match them.
_help.self_profile_url: Your own LinkedIn profile URL, so you never show up as a creator or a prospect.
_help.creator_urls: Optional. Paste creator profile URLs here to skip discovery and use exactly these creators.
_help.creators_top_n: How many top creators discovery keeps.
_help.posts_per_creator: Recent posts pulled per creator when picking which posts to scrape.
_help.top_posts: How many posts, ranked by comment count, get their commenters scraped.
_help.comments_per_post: Most comments pulled from each of those posts.
_help.qualify_threshold: Prospects scored below this are rejected and never contacted.
_help.per_run_cap_usd: Most a single Apify run may cost. A bigger job is refused before it starts and offered in smaller batches.
_help.total_cap_usd: Most all Apify runs together may cost. Raise it on purpose when you want more prospects.
_help.aimfox_campaign_id: The id of the paused campaign you built by hand. See references/aimfox-campaign-setup.md.
_help.unipile_account_id: The id Unipile shows for your connected LinkedIn account. Must be the same LinkedIn account Aimfox sends from.
_help.closer_mode: send = replies go out automatically. draft_only = replies and comment replies are written and stored, never sent.
_help.reply_scope: campaign_only = only people the prospector contacted get automatic replies; everyone else is drafted and listed for you. all = everyone in your inbox gets automatic replies, including customers and friends.
_help.closer_replies_per_day: Most DM replies sent in any rolling 24 hours.
_help.comment_replies_per_day: Most replies to comments on your own posts in any rolling 24 hours.
